title: export/sync: retired/date near 9999 crashes with OverflowError
description:
A `retired` (or demotion `date`) near year 9999 passes check, then crashes export and sync with a traceback for every user.

Where (HEAD 4237c43): allowed_signers at git-vouch:2173 does `end = min(before) + END_SLACK`. _date (667-676) accepts any year from 0001 to 9999. datetime + timedelta raises OverflowError, which neither cmd_export (2232) nor cmd_sync (2396) catches (they catch only OSError).

Reproduced (scratchpad a1/dates.sh big): alice, a contributor, sets her own key's "retired": "9999-12-31T23:30:00Z" in a self-signed edit. `check` passes with exit 0, so a merger has no signal. `export` dies with "OverflowError: date value out of range" and a traceback. Every user's `sync` then writes the revocation file and crashes before allowed_signers. allowed_signers stays frozen at the last good export, so later tier deletions, demotions and new members never reach anyone until the record is fixed. That fails open for removals. An approver can trigger the same crash with a tier record `date` of 9999-12-31T23:xx (a demotion's `until`).

Related, same root cause: years 0001-0999 parse, but on Linux CPython 3.12 strftime("%Y") does not zero-pad, so `valid-after="9990101000000Z"`. OpenSSH rejects that one line ("bad options") and skips it, which harms only that key's holder.

Fix: bound record years in _date to a range that survives END_SLACK and formats as four digits, e.g. 1970-9998, and report anything else as a record problem in check. Also catch OverflowError at the export boundary as defence in depth.
notes: Close reason corrected 2026-10-23: test_tier_ended_at_the_end_of_time_exports was renamed test_tier_ended_at_the_end_of_time_is_refused in 26f41f4 (a 9999 commit date is now refused as future); the cap is covered by test_valid_before_is_capped_at_the_end_of_time.
close_reason: check rejects record dates outside 1970-9998 (test_records BAD_DATES, first-year/last-year); allowed_signers caps valid-before at 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z (test_valid_before_is_capped_at_the_end_of_time, test_tier_ended_at_the_end_of_time_exports)
